C08 and C19 also operate directly on earlier executive orders, but their amendment formulas are generic and lack the child's land-restoration machinery.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"[DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] of April 25 1945, authorizing and directing the Secretary of War to assume full control of the public airport on the following described lands, in the State of Oregon, is hereby revoked","parent_excerpt":"WHEREAS by Executive Order No. 174 ... certain lands ... were set aside for the use of the United States Navy Department; and WHEREAS these lands are no longer needed for the use of the Navy Department ...
